facts.fact: E-rank hunter, the lowest license tier, earned just for surviving his first three gates
facts.quote: E-rank, the lowest tier issued, the kind you got for surviving your first three gates instead of doing anything impressive in them.

facts.fact: Level 9 with no assigned Class ('Rankless') for longer than anyone his teammate has known
facts.quote: You've been Rankless longer than anyone I've met.

facts.fact: dies in a collapsed tunnel and is granted the class Graveborn, making death no longer permanent for him
facts.quote: Death is no longer permanent for you. Use this wisely. It will not be free forever.

facts.fact: single-handedly kills the boss monster (Chamber Keeper) with his bare hand after resurrecting
facts.quote: he put his new hand through the boss's core, and everybody noticed him

facts.fact: dry, self-aware, doesn't fully believe his own reassurances
facts.quote: He doesn't believe that. Neither do I, some days.

facts.fact: deadpan, terse replies even after surviving his own death
facts.quote: I don't feel very presumed.

facts.fact: betrayed by party leader Talon Reyes, who deliberately seals him in a collapsing tunnel to shrink the loot split
facts.quote: Sorry, kid. Six-way split doesn't work as well as five-way. Nothing personal.

facts.fact: Mira Voss, a teammate who didn't know about the betrayal, wants to keep working with him afterward
facts.quote: I'd like to work with you again. If you're taking a new team.

antiFacts.claim: described physical appearance (hair, eye color, build)
antiFacts.why: text never physically describes Jonah at all, in keeping with the story's sparse characterization of him

antiFacts.claim: has a tragic dead-family backstory driving him
antiFacts.why: no family or personal backstory is given for Jonah anywhere in the excerpt

antiFacts.claim: wields a signature weapon such as a scythe
antiFacts.why: he kills bare-handed ('his hand closed around its throat', 'put his new hand through the boss's core'); no weapon is ever attributed to him

antiFacts.claim: was already a skilled, respected fighter before his class awakening
antiFacts.why: contradicted; he is explicitly the lowest tier, dismissed by Talon, and only becomes formidable after dying and gaining the Graveborn class

antiFacts.claim: leads his hunting team
antiFacts.why: contradicted; Talon Reyes gives the orders and Jonah is described as merely tolerated, not a leader

facts.fact: wears sect gold robes as an elder on the ranking platform
facts.quote: Elder Kang stood on the ranking platform in sect gold, hands folded into his sleeves.

facts.fact: oversees outer court discipline and ranking day
facts.quote: He oversaw outer court discipline.

facts.fact: revealed as a traitor who sold sect secrets to Blackfang for a promotion elsewhere; stripped of rank and expelled
facts.quote: You sold us for a promotion in another sect

facts.fact: openly hates Lin Xiao for reasons never explained in the text
facts.quote: He also hated Lin Xiao, for reasons Lin Xiao had never been given and had stopped asking about.

facts.fact: caught keeping secret late-night meetings before his own downfall
facts.quote: Twice, walking back from the far training ground after midnight, Lin Xiao saw lantern light in Elder Kang's study long after it should have been dark.

facts.fact: senior to but less well-liked than Elder Su Wan, who publicly checks his authority
facts.quote: Elder Su Wan was junior to him but well liked

antiFacts.claim: has a long white beard
antiFacts.why: no facial hair is ever described; a beard is a classic cultivation-genre invention, not textually supported

antiFacts.claim: carries or wields a wooden staff
antiFacts.why: never described with any weapon or staff; his authority is administrative, not shown in combat

antiFacts.claim: elderly with white hair
antiFacts.why: no age or hair description is given beyond the title 'Elder' and his gold robes

antiFacts.claim: secretly related to Lin Xiao (e.g. a hidden relative)
antiFacts.why: the text explicitly leaves the reason for his hatred unexplained; no family connection is stated

antiFacts.claim: displays visible cultivation/combat powers on the page
antiFacts.why: he is never shown fighting; his role is administrative authority and later espionage, not demonstrated combat ability

facts.fact: seventeen years old, robes patched at the elbow, sword slung crooked on his back
facts.quote: robes patched at the elbow, sword slung crooked on his back. He was seventeen.

facts.fact: arrived at the sect gates twelve years ago, half frozen and five years old, with no known family name or sponsor
facts.quote: Lin Xiao had no family name anyone recognized, no sponsor, no sect elder who claimed him as a student.

facts.fact: revealed to be the son of Lin Feiyu, a former Sect Master believed to be a traitor who disappeared twelve years ago
facts.quote: Lin Xiao is Inner Court, direct disciple candidate, and no one here will lay a hand on him again.

facts.fact: stubbornly refuses to submit even under threat of expulsion
facts.quote: "Keep the stipend," he said.

facts.fact: trains obsessively before dawn and after dusk for a month, achieving a secret cultivation breakthrough
facts.quote: For the next month Lin Xiao trained before dawn and after dusk, qi circulation until his meridians burned

facts.fact: defeats his rival Chen Feng decisively in their rematch after the secret breakthrough
facts.quote: Lin Xiao's first strike broke Chen Feng's guard clean in half.

facts.fact: taken in and raised by Elder Su Wan, who has cared for and mentored him since childhood
facts.quote: the only reason the sect had taken him in at all was that Elder Su Wan happened to be the one standing watch that night

facts.fact: Yue Lian, an Inner Court disciple, has been kind to him and supports him despite his low status
facts.quote: Yue Lian brought him food twice without being asked and didn't mention it either time.

antiFacts.claim: tall, broad-shouldered, physically imposing build
antiFacts.why: no build is described beyond his age and patched robes; his cultivation strength is narrative, not a described physique

antiFacts.claim: carries a named, signature sword
antiFacts.why: his sword is referred to only generically ('his sword'); it is never named

antiFacts.claim: has a large circle of friends among the outer disciples
antiFacts.why: contradicted; he is isolated and mocked by the crowd, with only Yue Lian and Elder Su Wan shown to be kind to him

antiFacts.claim: his mother is a known warrior or figure in the sect
antiFacts.why: his mother is never identified or described; only a brief, unelaborated line about her being proud of him

antiFacts.claim: openly proud of or quick to reveal his lineage as Lin Feiyu's son
antiFacts.why: contradicted; he doesn't even know his own family name until Elder Su Wan and Sect Master Duan reveal it to him

facts.fact: sixteen-year-old only daughter of Duke Alaric Calderwood
facts.quote: Lady Iris Calderwood. Sixteen. The Duke's only daughter.

facts.fact: reincarnated soul of a 26-year-old woman killed in a car accident, who recognizes her new life as a novel she once read
facts.quote: I am the girl who dies so the plot can move on.

facts.fact: her birth mother is Rosalind, last of the silverwolf bloodline, who gave her up as an infant to protect her
facts.quote: I gave you up within the week, because the Ashgrave family was hunting the last of the silverwolf bloodline and I could not protect you and hide at the same time.

facts.fact: defiantly refuses her arranged betrothal in public despite the consequences
facts.quote: "I won't marry the Crown Prince."

facts.fact: duels Lady Seraphine Ashgrave and wins using a sudden, unfamiliar silverwolf power awakened from a mark on her shoulder blade
facts.quote: Something under Iris's skin answered instead, old and cold and entirely unfamiliar, rising up her spine from the mark on her shoulder blade like water finding a crack.

facts.fact: betrothed to Crown Prince Cassian, who agrees to a political contract with a year's delay instead of an actual wedding
facts.quote: Not that kind. A different contract. Political alliance, public appearances when required, no wedding for at least a year

facts.fact: a mysterious old woman in temple grey recognizes that Iris shouldn't still be alive 'at this point in the story'
facts.quote: You're not supposed to be alive at this point in the story

antiFacts.claim: described as blonde or with a specific hair/eye color
antiFacts.why: no physical appearance is described for Iris beyond her age and title; hair/eye color are never stated

antiFacts.claim: a trained fighter or swordswoman before the duel
antiFacts.why: contradicted; her win comes from a sudden, involuntary magical awakening ('old and cold and entirely unfamiliar'), not prior combat training

antiFacts.claim: has siblings
antiFacts.why: she is explicitly called 'the Duke's only daughter'

antiFacts.claim: openly tells others she is a reincarnated soul from another world
antiFacts.why: contradicted; her knowledge of being reincarnated is kept entirely internal/secret, never spoken aloud to other characters

antiFacts.claim: in love with Prince Cassian
antiFacts.why: contradicted; their arrangement is explicitly a political contract ('Not that kind. A different contract'), not a romantic relationship
